title: Whole input read into memory without a limit (javascript)
description: javascript code reads an entire stream or file into memory (fs.readFileSync). Nothing bounds the size, so a large or hostile input — a decompression bomb, a huge upload, a slow stream — exhausts the worker and takes the endpoint down. This lexical rule flags the read; the reviewer adds a limit.
remediation: Stream the data, or cap it before reading (for example a bounded stream with a byte limit) and reject inputs above the cap with a clear error.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: flags the read even where the source is a small internal file.
